## Description

The consultation opens as one page: the patient strip with life stage and allergies, the recording consent bar first (patient agreed, declined so the doctor types, consent withdrawn while listening), then numbered sections Vitals, History, the adaptive template (MDV-P2-042), Examination, Assessment, Plan (MDV-P2-043) and Review and sign (MDV-P2-044), with a section bar that stays at the top and ticks each finished section. A switch flips to the existing guided steps; nothing of the old flow is lost. The right panel has Assist suggestions, a chart summary and the checklist.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The one-page and guided views save the same note; switching keeps every typed word (autosave as today).
- [ ] **AC2.** The section bar is a nav landmark with links that move focus to the section; ticks are icon and words.
- [ ] **AC3.** Declined consent hides Assist and keeps the manual note path as today.
- [ ] **AC4.** Desktop two columns, phone one column, Arabic right to left, axe clean.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
